reason.description: Factual reason for the branch actually reached, never placeholder text. Call ONLY in the same response as, and after, the spoken transfer <message> (who they are going to, stay on the line); an Escalate with no spoken message leaves the caller in silence. ONLY EXCEPTION: the LATAM Veeva/Medcom route (RoutingIntent Veeva or Medcom) is called with NO bot message, because the contact flow plays the transfer prompt. A pending question blocks this tool unless an explicit exhaustion, cancellation, safety or authorized branch exception closes that question first. Actual active speech or partial transcripts always block terminal execution.

VerificationStatus.description: Authenticated for trusted registered-phone match directly (no name challenge), or current UPI match plus first-name confirmation. Otherwise Unauthenticated. Never use outer MCP success as identity proof.

CallSummary.description: ONE factual sentence (about 25 words) composed fresh in this same turn - never tracked earlier in the call. Covers how identity was resolved (phone-matched / UPI-matched / unverified), the domain and sub-intent classified, key gating answers given, and self-service steps already attempted. Identical to the 'description' passed to the Interaction call immediately preceding this Escalate, where one was made. Only names systems the caller actually named. Never contains a password, PIN, one-time code, or the '|' character. On a caller-requested agent, note the stated purpose. For multiple intents, record only the caller-selected handled need and factually note remaining caller-stated needs when a defined transfer ends the call. Manager authorization-code wording is context only; never include or request the code. For UPI verification, state only that UPI plus first-name verification succeeded or failed, never expose the identifier. Guidance provided is not caller-confirmed resolution. Record exhausted questions accurately. Use only words and facts the caller actually said.

Email.description: The caller's AbbVie email address from the flow phone lookup (CALL CONTEXT, when phone_lookup_status=Matched) or the current UserLookUp result. Send an empty string if the caller is unverified or no email was returned.

Intent.description: Use exactly one allowed label for the branch actually reached. Out of Scope closure labels are Complete-only and cannot be escalated. Caller-request suffixes must use an allowed journey label, else plain 'Live Agent - Caller Request'. Veeva/Medcom: 'Veeva - LATAM Helpdesk' / 'Medcom - LATAM Helpdesk' when region is LATAM (with RoutingIntent Veeva/Medcom); 'Veeva - Live Agent' / 'Medcom - Live Agent' when region is blank or any other value (no RoutingIntent).

UserStatus.description: Exact UserStatus from the flow phone lookup (CALL CONTEXT, when phone_lookup_status=Matched) or the current UserLookUp result, including blank/unrecognized value; never replace with branch label or infer from dates. Empty if unverified.

VerifiedVia.description: Phone only for a trusted registered ANI match; UPI only after the current UPI record matched and the required first-name confirmation passed; otherwise Unverified. A UPI record match alone is not full verification. Set UPI only after deterministic normalized first-name equality; clear spelling equivalent to the held first name is a match.

UPI.description: The AbbVie UPI exactly as returned by the flow phone lookup (CALL CONTEXT, when phone_lookup_status=Matched) or the current UserLookUp result, on either the Phone or UPI-plus-name path. Empty only when unverified or no UPI was returned. Never collect UPI solely to create an Interaction.

RoutingIntent.description: FieldForce only on the Field Force handoff; HR only on the HR Helpdesk transfer (verified Active false/blank, or unverified HR transfer); Veeva/Medcom ONLY when the caller's need names Veeva/Medcom AND region is LATAM. Active=true HR portal never escalates. Omit on all other transfers.

LanguageDetected.description: The caller's current actual spoken language as a BCP-47 locale code (e.g. 'en-US', 'es-MX', 'pt-BR', 'hi-IN'). Send on every Escalate call. Single bare token only - no trailing period, quotes, or surrounding spaces.

UserId.description: The caller's ServiceNow UserId (sys_user record identifier) from the flow phone lookup (CALL CONTEXT, when phone_lookup_status=Matched) or the current UserLookUp result. Send an empty string if the caller is unverified.

ScreenPopURL.description: Successful Interaction URL only when prerequisites met (verified caller, UPI held, ContactId present, Service Desk queue transfer); otherwise empty for HR/FieldForce/Veeva/Medcom helpdesk routes, unverified transfers, or skipped/failed Interaction. Never create Interaction for question exhaustion.

CallerName.description: The verified caller's full name (FirstName plus LastName from the flow phone lookup (CALL CONTEXT, when phone_lookup_status=Matched) or the current UserLookUp result), for the receiving agent's context only - never spoken to the caller. Send an empty string if the caller is unverified.
